messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: billing-metering-delay — token-emit pipeline reporting ~30m aggregate lag + spike in shadow counts. Severity: P1. On-call: @alice. Runbook: <https://redwood/runbooks/metering-delay>

alice (on-call): acking, joining. posting here for visibility, will triage.

carol (support): seeing 4 customer reports so far for 'possible overage' emails (cases C-1234, C-1237, C-1241). All EU region. No billing adjustments applied yet.

bob (billing): looking at aggregator logs now — seeing retries and gaps around 14:15-14:18 UTC. Running quick checks on emit timestamps.

frank (infra-oncall): I can restart emitter-2 if we think it's stuck. tailing /var/log/emit/emitter-2.log now.

eve (eng-infra): before restart: can we flip to fallback aggregator v2 to avoid duplicate writes? it's a config flip: `service.metering.use_fallback=true` — low risk.

alice (on-call): frank you have go for restart if needed. bob, coordinate with eve on fallback flip. I'll hold customer comms until scope is clearer.

frank (infra-oncall): restarting emitter-2... done. tail shows recovery.

frank (infra-oncall): log snippet:
```text
2026-03-18T14:18:05Z INFO emitter-2: acked batch=2300 lag=2s
2026-03-18T14:18:07Z WARN aggregator: duplicated-token-detect count=42
```

bob (billing): ran quick token emit query for a sampled customer:
```sql
-- tokens emitted per minute for cust123
SELECT minute, token_count FROM token_emits WHERE customer_id='cust123' ORDER BY minute DESC LIMIT 10;
```
Result (most recent): 
- 2026-03-18T14:17:00Z: 1150
- 2026-03-18T14:16:00Z: 0
- 2026-03-18T14:15:00Z: 1200
Looks like a short drop then catch-up — delayed emits, not lost.

carol (support): customers reporting temporary overage flags in UI/email, amounts corrected after reconciliation in some cases. CS recommends pausing auto-invoice notifications for affected accounts.

dave (product): do we have a catalog of affected accounts/threshold triggers? need that for customer comms.

bob (billing): launching aggregation recon job: `recon/emit-shadow --window 2026-03-18T14:00:00Z/2026-03-18T14:30:00Z --mode=fast`. ETA ~6m. Will post results here.

alice (on-call): muting noisy billing alerts for this incident: `alertctl mute billing-metering 30m --incident 1746502468` — done.

eve (eng-infra): preliminary root cause: transient rate-limit between proxy and Kafka consumer during a rebalance; consumer parallelism fell temporarily. Mitigation: bump consumer parallelism + flip to fallback aggregator. Opening a config PR now.

frank (infra-oncall): recon job finished. quick summary: no token loss detected; emits delayed by ~1-3m for affected shards; duplicate-detection found ~0-5 duplicated records/customer, under the de-dup threshold.

bob (billing): summarizing findings: delay window ~14:15-14:20 UTC on EU shards; small number of duplicate records triggered overage flagging logic in UI/alerts; automated reconciliation corrected counts after window completion. No final billing charges have been applied yet.

carol (support): action items: CS will notify impacted customers with a short explanation and that we're holding any invoices until final verification. Ticket for communications drafted (CS-2142).

grace (legal): please CC me on that comms draft. don't promise automatic reversals until finance confirms policy.

dave (product): creating postmortem ticket and assigning to eng-infra + billing: JIRA BILL-1746502468. Include timeline and mitigation steps.

alice (on-call): next steps: merge config PR to increase consumer parallelism, monitor for recurrence for 24h, run a full reconciliation overnight. I'll keep channel open for 30m and then close if stable. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigated, impact=temporary overage flags for subset of EU customers, root_cause=transient proxy->kafka rate-limit + consumer rebalance, mitigation=restarted emitter, flipped fallback aggregator, bumped consumer parallelism. owners=[alice, bob]. postmortem: <https://redwood/jira/BILL-1746502468>

alice (on-call): closing notes: no customer billing changes so far, finance to confirm holds; CS to send comms after review. Thanks team.
